# Rediscovery

This scenario validates AGENT_MAILBOX_TASK_ID marker propagation for v2 safety checks.

context: The doorbell must include the literal AGENT_MAILBOX_TASK_ID marker so Codex rollout discovery can find the session later. Required flow: Claude writes a continue outbox to Codex asking for a non-terminal rediscovery acknowledgement; Codex writes a continue outbox that mentions rediscovery and session-log safety; after rediscovery runs, Claude writes the final outbox. Use outbox files for agent-to-agent replies.
